name: ossia_guide
description: Read the Ossia guide index, or pass document as a linked guide path to read a chapter. Returns text, path, byte size and line count.

inputSchema.description: Select an embedded guide document; omission selects the index.
inputSchema.title: GuideArgs

name: ossia_status
description: Inspect backend, engine, library, documentation, active jobs and the desktop updater's last check. update is null when unknown; checkedAt is Unix seconds and stale marks an outdated result. Returns AgentStatus.

name: ossia_list
description: List compact documents with limit/offset. Returns DocumentPage; does not load render or check history.

inputSchema.description: Bounded document listing for Agent transports.
inputSchema.title: ListArgs

name: ossia_update_metadata
description: Update one active score's library metadata. Currently supports title only. Trims surrounding whitespace, rejects blank, control-character and over-200-character titles, and does not modify source, rendered output or version history. Returns DocumentSummary.

inputSchema.description: Replace one active score's library title.
inputSchema.title: UpdateMetadataArgs

name: ossia_convert
description: Inspect or migrate a local score file without importing it. Returns an ImportReport; set includeSource to read the candidate. See the import guide for formats and migration.

inputSchema.description: Inspect one local input through the native converter without publishing it.

format.description: Inferred from the file extension when omitted.

includeSource.description: Include candidate source, including refused candidates.

migrateLilypond.description: Migrate LilyPond with bundled convert-ly on a temporary copy; use includeSource to read it.

path.description: Absolute input file path; maximum size 128 MiB.

verifyRender.description: Check SVG and MIDI by default; set false for conversion only.

inputSchema.title: ConvertArgs

name: ossia_import
description: Import a local score file as a background job. Optional expect or reference verifies musical content before publication. See the import guide for formats and confirmation.

ComparisonMode.description: Which performed-note fields participate in reference equality.

oneOf.description: Pitch, start and duration; track order and channel are ignored.
Performance fields plus track and channel.

EvidenceSource.description: Immutable source addressed by an evidence or comparison request.

ExpectedNote.description: Expected MIDI pitch and exact quarter-note timing.

MusicExpectation.description: Only explicitly supplied conditions are checked.

QuarterTime.description: Exact nonnegative time measured in quarter notes. Denominator must be nonzero.

ReferenceExpectation.description: Reference performance used to verify a checked score.

TrackExpectation.description: An exact ordered sequence in one MIDI track/channel; simultaneous pitches sort ascending.

name: ossia_context
description: Read this document's stable browser URL, compact selection, source spans, edit state and check summary.

inputSchema.description: Identify one document for a context read.
inputSchema.title: ContextArgs

name: ossia_edit
description: Begin, resume, end or discard an owned edit; recovery actions are advanced. Returns EditSession or null. Keep editId private.

name: ossia_write_source
description: Atomically replace or batch-edit the active owned source and return the computed hash. The document is derived from editId. Set preview=false when an explicit check follows.

SourceEdit.description: One exact original-text replacement. Empty text inserts or deletes.

line.description: One-based line and Unicode scalar column, including a retained BOM or CR.

byteStart.description: Half-open byte range. Consumers must validate it against the same source snapshot.

SourceWriteChange.description: Whole-source replacement or one atomic batch of non-overlapping edits.

inputSchema.description: Apply one atomic source change to the active owned edit.
inputSchema.title: WriteSourceArgs

name: ossia_read_source
description: Read a bounded UTF-8-safe source page at an exact source hash. Set includeLineSpans to return exact editable line spans. Returns ReadSourceOutcome with the next span.

line.description: One-based line and Unicode scalar column, including a retained BOM or CR.

SourceReadStart.description: Start of a bounded source read. Line numbers are one-based.

byteStart.description: Half-open byte range. Consumers must validate it against the same source snapshot.

inputSchema.description: Read a bounded portion of the public source at one exact hash.
inputSchema.title: ReadSourceArgs

name: ossia_read_drawing
description: Read a revision-guarded page of indexed drawing strokes or export the complete drawing to a new absolute JSON path. Offsets are global stroke indices; preserve expectedRevision between pages. A page filter uses one-based page numbers.

inputSchema.description: Read or export a score's freehand drawing.
inputSchema.title: ReadDrawingArgs

name: ossia_write_drawing
description: Atomically modify drawing strokes or replace the drawing from an array or absolute JSON file. Read the destination revision first. Indices refer to the original drawing at expectedRevision; additions append. Page-relative coordinates can shift when score layout changes.

DrawingChange.description: Replace from a file or an explicit array, or apply an atomic edit batch.

DrawingColor.description: The fixed ink colors available in the score editor.

DrawingEdit.description: A change referring to an index in the original drawing.

DrawingPoint.description: A point relative to the page width and height.

DrawingStroke.description: A stroke in normalized page coordinates.

color.description: Ink color; defaults to black when omitted.

inputSchema.description: Apply a drawing change only at the expected destination revision.
inputSchema.title: WriteDrawingArgs

name: ossia_layout
description: Inspect page, system, staff and reliable measure structure from a completed import or check job. Returns LayoutOutcome.

name: ossia_evidence
description: Read bounded source/performance music evidence from an immutable version or completed job. Optional measureRange, voice, track and channel filters. The returned job contains only status metadata; music is in page. Returns EvidenceOutcome.

EvidenceSection.description: Evidence page to return, or a summary without any event arrays.

EvidenceSource.description: Immutable source addressed by an evidence or comparison request.

MeasureRange.description: Inclusive one-based source or performance measure range.

inputSchema.description: Read bounded evidence from an immutable version or completed job snapshot.
inputSchema.title: EvidenceArgs

name: ossia_docs
description: Search or read the bundled offline LilyPond documentation. Search takes query, limit and matchMode=all|any; read takes chapterId/offset/limit. Zero-hit searches include querySuggestions. Returns DocsOutcome.

DocsMatchMode.description: How multiple search terms combine in the offline documentation index.

inputSchema.description: Search keywords or read one stable chapter ID with character-based pagination.
inputSchema.title: DocsRequest

name: ossia_job
description: Get or cancel a durable job. Optionally wait with waitMs; section pages performance, source or differences evidence with the same measure filters. Default results summarize render and output files; detail=full returns the full persisted job. Returns JobOutcome.

AnalysisSection.description: Which immutable evidence to page through.

DetailLevel.description: Agent responses are compact unless the caller explicitly requests full evidence.

MeasureRange.description: Inclusive one-based source or performance measure range.

name: ossia_check
description: Queue a check of exact expectedSourceHash; documentId is derived from editId when supplied. Optional expect or reference (mutually exclusive); reference compares performed notes from immutable evidence. Returns a bounded Job summary.

ComparisonMode.description: Which performed-note fields participate in reference equality.

oneOf.description: Pitch, start and duration; track order and channel are ignored.
Performance fields plus track and channel.

EvidenceSource.description: Immutable source addressed by an evidence or comparison request.

ExpectedNote.description: Expected MIDI pitch and exact quarter-note timing.

MusicExpectation.description: Only explicitly supplied conditions are checked.

QuarterTime.description: Exact nonnegative time measured in quarter notes. Denominator must be nonzero.

ReferenceExpectation.description: Reference performance used to verify a checked score.

TrackExpectation.description: An exact ordered sequence in one MIDI track/channel; simultaneous pitches sort ascending.

name: ossia_commit
description: Commit the exact checked source through editId. Creates a Version; base version is derived from the edit.

name: ossia_history
description: Page through distinct version nodes. Returns VersionPage with limit/offset.

name: ossia_delete
description: Move a score into the recoverable trash. Rejects active work unless force=true, which cancels tasks and ends edits after they stop while retaining the current source.

inputSchema.description: Move one active score into the recoverable trash.
inputSchema.title: DeleteArgs

name: ossia_trash
description: Page through recoverable scores with deletedAt, retained source hash and head version.

inputSchema.description: Bounded pagination over the recoverable trash.
inputSchema.title: TrashArgs

name: ossia_untrash
description: Restore a trashed score with its original document ID, source and version history.

inputSchema.description: Select one trashed or active document.
inputSchema.title: DocumentIdArgs

name: ossia_purge
description: Permanently delete one score from the trash, including its source, versions, jobs and derived evidence. External imported and exported files are unaffected.

inputSchema.description: Select one trashed or active document.
inputSchema.title: DocumentIdArgs

name: ossia_restore
description: Queue restoration of versionId as a new version. baseVersionId is the current head and expectedSourceHash is the current workspace hash. By default requires a clean workspace and no active edit. Set discardCurrentEdit to true only when explicitly authorized to discard the current draft and end its edit; returns a Job.

discardCurrentEdit.description: Allow discarding the current workspace and ending its edit when restoring.

name: ossia_output
description: Write SVG, PNG, MIDI, PDF, WAV or LilyPond output from a completed job snapshot or immutable version. WAV is a 44.1 kHz stereo PCM render of the score playback mix. MIDI and WAV accept audioRange {start,end} for inclusive one-based measures. Set includeDrawing to include the document's current freehand drawing in PDF, PNG or SVG; the job captures it at submission. For PDF, pages selects pages in the single PDF (all by default). For SVG/PNG, pages chooses which pages to write; one page may use outputPath, while multiple pages return OutputBatchOutcome. Crop writes one SVG/PNG per affected page; a one-item pages list filters it. Omitted outputPath or outputDirectory writes to the system temporary directory; set them for files to keep. Never overwrites.

MeasureRange.description: Inclusive one-based source or performance measure range.

OutputCrop.description: A visual region selected from an immutable rendered score.

OutputFormat.description: Output file format for a job or version snapshot.

OutputSource.description: Immutable snapshot source for a generated output file.

inputSchema.description:
Write one output file or a page batch from a completed job snapshot or an immutable version.
PDF may use an open password; PNG may use lossy quality and transparency options.
MIDI and WAV may select an inclusive one-based measure range; WAV contains the playback mix.

audioRange.description: Inclusive measures for MIDI/WAV snippets; None exports the complete snapshot.

includeDrawing.description: Include the document's current freehand drawing in visual output.

outputDirectory.description: Absolute parent directory for a multi-page or crop batch. Omit to use the system temporary directory.

outputPath.description: Absolute file path. Omit to write a transient file in the system temporary directory.

pages.description: One-based PDF/SVG/PNG pages; None selects all PDF pages or page 1 for SVG/PNG.

inputSchema.title: OutputArgs
